column1: For a DAB entity backed by a SQL view, set source.type to {{c1::view}}.
column2:
Set source.object to the database view name, such as dbo.ProductInventory.
Review source

column1: In DAB 2.0+, identify a view's key columns with {{c1::primary-key}} flags in the entity's fields array.
column2:
Set each key flag to true. DAB 1.x uses source.key-fields, which cannot coexist with fields in DAB 2.0.
Review source

column1: For a DAB entity backed by a SQL procedure, set source.type to {{c1::stored-procedure}}.
column2:
Set source.object to the procedure name, such as dbo.GetProductsByPriceRange.
Review source

column1: The DAB permission action for invoking a stored procedure is {{c1::execute}}.
column2:
Grant it to the intended API role instead of using the read action for procedure invocation.
Review source

column1: If rest.methods is omitted for a DAB stored-procedure endpoint, its default HTTP method is {{c1::POST}}.
column2:
Configure other intended methods explicitly.
Review source

column1: A POST request to a DAB stored-procedure endpoint supplies its input parameters in the {{c1::JSON request body}}.
column2:
Use the procedure's parameter names rather than assuming that source.parameters defines aliases.
Review source

column1: In DAB 2.0+, the preferred source.parameters format is an {{c1::array of parameter objects}}.
column2:
Example: [{"name":"MinPrice","required":false,"default":0}]. The legacy dictionary format is deprecated but still accepted.
Review source

column1: For a DAB stored procedure that changes data, configure graphql.operation as {{c1::mutation}}.
column2:
This places the generated operation under Mutation. Use query for a procedure intended to retrieve data.
Review source

column1: With default naming, DAB procedure entity GetProducts generates the GraphQL field {{c1::executeGetProducts}}.
column2:
Pass procedure inputs as GraphQL arguments to this generated field.
Review source

column1: For Order to multiple OrderDetail entities, set DAB relationship cardinality to {{c1::many}}.
column2:
Use one when a source row relates to a single target object, such as an order's customer.
Review source

column1: A DAB relationship names its destination entity through the {{c1::target.entity}} property.
column2:
Use the configured entity name rather than the underlying SQL table name.
Review source

column1: To model a DAB many-to-many relationship without exposing the junction table, configure {{c1::linking.object}}.
column2:
Set linking.source.fields and linking.target.fields to the corresponding junction-table columns.
Review source
